messages:
alex_sentosa: Draft from partner (Skyline Systems) attached. It's a one-pager + quote we want to co-publish. Link: https://files.redwood.co/skyline-case-draft
sarah_pm: thanks. quick pass: quote looks good but need partner logo SVG with clearspace. can we get a white-bg and transparent version? @jordan_brand
jordan_brand: noted. skyline logos in their brand kit are okay but their preferred colors clash w/ ours on dark bg. propose lockup with white logo for dark backgrounds. i'll upload mockups in a min :upload:
matt_p: also check the hero screenshot — partner left-side footer includes internal IP strings, need to blur before publish
alex_sentosa: good catch. @lisa_legal can we get confirmation on the customer quote usage? and a short legal blurb for the co-publish?
lisa_legal: confirmed we need signed quote release. also add a partner attribution line: "Skyline Systems (partner)" and include a trademark footnote. i'll DM contract owner to expedite.
jordan_brand: uploaded two lockup options: skyline-on-white.svg and skyline-on-black.svg plus vertical/horizontal lockups. filenames: skyline_lockup_h.png, skyline_lockup_v.png
sarah_pm: re: layout - prefer horizontal lockup for hero, vertical for card. Keep alt text: "Skyline Systems + Redwood Inference: real-time inference for supply chain". also add partner logo link tracking for downstream analytics.
matt_p: i'm going to scrub the screenshot now. command i'm running:
```
# remove internal IPs
sed -E 's/(10\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)/[REDACTED]/g' hero-screenshot.png
```
will push cleaned asset to the folder when done.
alex_sentosa: timeline? we want to publish with partner next Tue EOD. can marketing ops schedule publish?
sarah_pm: ops ok with Tue if legal signs today and partner approves logos by EOD tomorrow.
lisa_legal: i've pinged partner legal. ETA 18h.
jordan_brand: small ask: partner uses a gradient in their brand — we should ask for a flattened single-color version to ensure legibility at 40px. sending sample render.
alex_sentosa: noted. final checklist:
- [ ] logo SVG white/transparent
- [ ] logo lockups (h + v)
- [ ] cleaned hero screenshot
- [ ] signed quote release
- [ ] alt text + attribution line
- [ ] tracking links
matt_p: i'll update the assets folder with cleaned screenshots + a readme of edits.
sarah_pm: thanks team. tagging @partner_ops to remind Skyline to sign.
alex_sentosa: :thumbsup: any other blockers?
jordan_brand: none from design once we get flattened color.
sarah_pm: i'll compile final content and share draft with partner for copy ok by tomorrow noon.
